svg.text: PART A - tank cell (instantiate 2x: T = P1 / P2)
PART C - combine the 8 bullets and the 2 tanks into the three pixel streams for the mixer (Fig 10)
Fig 9 - Sprite Engine: Per-Pixel Tank and Bullet Hit Test (x, y from the VGA timing generator)

offset = (x - sprite_x, y - sprite_y). Unsigned subtract makes 'negative' offsets huge, so ONE compare (offset < size) tests both edges. If inside the box, a small ROM gives the shape bit (1 clk latency, so the in-box flag is delayed 1 FF).
sync read: shape bit 1 clk later
Both tanks run in parallel; the two {rgb, valid} pairs are combined in Part C.
sync read: shape bit 1 clk later
Bullet cell latency = 1 clk (ROM / FF), same as the tank cell. Colours: small = 12'hFF0 yellow, big = 12'hF00 red (constants in the mixer).
Tank overlap (rare): P2 wins via the select mux.
All three outputs are registered once (not drawn)
so the mixer sees stable inputs.
Outputs -> Fig 10 mixer: tank_rgb/tank_valid, bullet_valid (yellow), big_valid (red).
